methodology.state_input: 70 protocol-reused preparation_verification cases plus corresponding pre-event initial_cases
methodology.obstacle_cells: initial free cells minus event free cells; four-neighbour components
methodology.deferred_interpretation: deferred = (metadata.published_targets - covered) - free; the resulting set is checked against metadata.deferred_targets for every state; metadata published goals, current inspectable goals, covered history, and deferred goals are listed separately
methodology.old_route_role_interpretation: first service positions are reconstructed from initial_targets - covered - {current} before applying the event obstacle map; event-post target status is a separate field
methodology.range_inclusion_attribution: direct collision, local contact/anchor boundary closure, endpoint closure, multi-contact/anchor hull gaps, and PLUS extensions are separate mechanical labels; attribution is marked non-unique where the input geometry does not identify one cause; no label asserts unnecessary work
methodology.new_target_categories: active newly published cells split by old remaining route overlap, current location, and cells requiring a new route visit
methodology.range_rules: independently reconstructed via saved independent_plan/assignment audit adapters; graph distance in current free map, ties by lowest old_route index; R_PLUS1/R_PLUS2 add one/two service-boundary steps around R_SEED; endpoint legality closes outward
methodology.map_distance: Manhattan distance and pre-event free-grid BFS edge distance between separated blocked route contact spans
methodology.figure: SVG vector map view and distinct route-index sequence view; no spatial rectangle used as a route window
methodology.cross_batch: 69/70 joined on map_id,budget,repeat,seed,method; outputs compare route bytes, steps, source, timing, active stage, and per-stage terminal status
methodology.protocol_run_id_audit: final_120 is joined to protocol and the three original attempt ledgers by run_id; each protocol ID must have one successful returned attempt and a matching final row; one runner hash exception is accepted only for the exact expected and exact disclosed current hashes
